name: Listening Post
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Model releases, pricing changes, and status incidents from 29 curated AI-vendor sources, including community RSS mirrors for the vendors that publish no blog feed. Separate lanes, vendors you run floated to the top, quiet when nothing shipped.

barWidget.description: The pill only speaks when a model shipped or a provider is down; the panel is a drainable queue with Herald-standard keys. Twenty-nine curated sources across the major labs, providers, and AI tools, plus any feed you add yourself.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify on new model releases and unresolved status incidents. Engineering posts and changelog commits never notify.

schema.label: Rank by agents you use
schema.description: Reads the file names in the Agents plugin usage folder (read-only) so vendors you actually run float to the top of each lane.
